verdict.rationale: Devin provides its own embedded IDE where you can watch and take over its work (devin-docs-3), and Devin Desktop can import VS Code/Cursor settings (devin-docs-9), but this is Devin's own environment rather than a plugin/chat panel living inside the developer's existing IDE (VS Code, JetBrains, etc.). No evidence of a native VS Code/JetBrains extension enabling in-IDE chat. Missing for 10: dedicated IDE extension/plugin for chatting inside the developer's own IDE, independent confirmation of in-IDE chat UX quality.
